items.prompt: Does the point (3, -13) lie on the graph of y = -2x − 6?
choices: No; substituting x = 3 gives y = -12, not -13.

Solve for x and state the solution set: -5x − 11 < 9.

sections.title: Extension and challenge

items.prompt: In a solution, one line reads: From 3(x + 4) = 21 to 3x + 12 = 21. Which property justifies that step?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
